purpose: Long-form article body with an inline CTA card and sticky TOC sidebar, shared by blog-post and casestudy templates via RichText.jsx + placeholderArticle.js.

contentPolicy.citation: src/components/longform/placeholderArticle.js:1-9 — 'The clone does not reproduce article bodies (blog-post.md "Content rule"); every post renders this generic outbound-sales filler, written for the clone, inside the faithful template.' Deterministic per seed (string hash), so pages differ from each other but never change between loads.
contentPolicy.aiGenerationRule: AI generation for this field MAY produce new neutral outbound-sales-adjacent filler prose in this same structural shape (h2/h3, paragraphs with strong/em/links, a list, a blockquote, an image, a table, inline code, a code block). It must NEVER attempt to reconstruct or approximate Valley's real, unrecorded article text — that text was deliberately never captured (dumps show '[redacted N chars]', screenshots are blurred).

inline-article-image.guidance: Generic illustrative image inside placeholder body copy; safe to AI-generate brand-neutral imagery.
